lines.en: label kirinsoccergen2:
scene kirinsoccergen2
I make my way to the gym for soccer practice to find Kirin sitting up on top of the stage instead of practicing with the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: 我去体育馆看足球训练，结果发现 Kirin 坐在舞台顶上，而不是和其他女孩一起训练。

lines.en: She says something about how she hurt her ankle and is taking the day off, but she looks fine to me.
lines.zh: 她说自己脚踝受了伤，今天休息，可我看她好得很。

lines.en: I'm okay with it as it gives me someone to talk to. I mean, I'd be okay with it either way. I am a horrible representative for this soccer team.
lines.zh: 我无所谓，因为这样我就有个人说话了。我是说，怎样都无所谓。我是这支足球队糟糕透顶的代表。

lines.en: Regardless, I hop onto the stage and sit next to Kirin.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我跳上舞台，在 Kirin 旁边坐下。

lines.en: She initially tries starting a conversation with me but starts getting snippy once she realizes my eyes have been-
lines.zh: 她起初试图跟我搭话，但一发现我的视线——

lines.en: if bonus == True:
Well, let's just say my eyes have been basically bouncing back and forth between every girl on the team. I am only a man, after all.
lines.zh: 好吧，只能说我的视线基本上在队里每个女孩之间来回弹跳。毕竟我只是个男人。

lines.en: else:
Well, let's just say my eyes have been focused on how high the ceiling is in here.
lines.zh: 好吧，只能说我的视线一直盯着这里的天花板有多高。

lines.en: It's such a big gym.
scene black
if bonus == True:
She gets over it quickly and, to my surprise, even starts judging the girls along with me.
lines.zh: 她很快就缓过来了，而且让我意外的是，她甚至开始跟我一起点评那些女孩。

lines.en: Apparently, Kirin is a bit of a thigh connoisseur herself, so she's full of input and the two of us even come up with a rating system.
lines.zh: 看来 Kirin 本人也是个颇有大腿鉴赏造诣的人，所以她有一大堆意见，我们俩甚至还搞出了一套评分体系。

lines.en: It's a good rating system, too.
lines.zh: 而且是套不错的评分体系。

lines.en: But, it's immediately dismantled once I give her sister a perfect score.
lines.zh: 但在我给她姐姐打了满分之后，它立刻土崩瓦解。

lines.en: She did not like that very much.
$ kirin_love += 1
{i}Kirin's affection has increased to [kirin_love] even though you gave Karin's thighs a 10/10{/i}!
lines.zh: {i}Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]——尽管你给 Karin 的大腿打了 10/10{/i}！

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
